claim: Evaluated an AI news-bias aggregator in a workshop by comparing manual bias scoring and quote extraction against the tool's output.
detail: Selected one of five articles, summarized it in three bullets, rated bias before viewing the AI report, and recommended adding input examples to clarify expected analysis depth.

claim: On a team of five, scoped a capstone plan for an interactive twin prototype, system flow diagrams, and HIPAA and IRB ethics.
detail: Selected Figma, Adobe XD, Miro, Maze, Lookback, Otter, and Google Forms for planned prototyping and qualitative user testing.

claim: On a team of five, analyzed 12 competing health, symptom, mood, AI coaching, and food apps to position Human API.
detail: Reviewed Apple Health, Fitbit, Whoop, Lively, WebMD, Bearable, Daylio, Noom, MyFitnessPal, Lark, Nike Training, and Yuka for contextual gaps.

claim: On a team of five, compiled an eight-paper literature review on healthcare digital twins, EHR integration, and patient ethics.
detail: Surveyed scoping reviews, precision medicine frameworks, networking architectures, and qualitative mHealth user studies.

claim: On a team of five, specified a conversational health twin interface with EHR grounding, cycle syncing, and ingredient-level food flagging.
detail: Designed the concept to surface triggers like maltodextrin, gums, and seed oils without gamification or motivational nudges.

claim: On a team of five, defined the product vision for Human API, a reflective digital twin uniting EHR, biometric, cycle, and food data.
detail: Scoped for adults aged 18 to 45 using wearables to manage ongoing conditions and clinicians needing concise patient summaries.

claim: Peer-reviewed a biometric roommate-matching app proposal, evaluating its mixed-methods research plan and compatibility dashboard MVP.
detail: Recommended concrete competitive examples, clearer biometric data visualizations, explicit user privacy controls, and phone-versus-smartwatch experience comparisons.

claim: Critiqued a roommate-matching survey and joined an in-class debrief on screener flow and biometric data-sharing context.
detail: Completed all survey sections including two screener items, recommending upfront explanations of what biometric data is collected, how it is used, and how it improves matching.

claim: Evaluated a mobile and desktop group-travel prototype across five usability tasks and wrote structured UX feedback.
detail: Completed pre- and post-test questions covering voting, finance, mood check-in, and suggested activities, noting missing feature onboarding and discouraging task-skipping cues.

claim: Reviewed a final UCD presentation for a desktop and mobile group-travel app, assessing how iterative usability testing drove redesigns.
detail: Evaluated alignment between competitor analysis, user interviews, journey maps, heat-map click tracking, and remediation of budgeting and voting flows.

claim: Reviewed a final UCD presentation for a screenless haptic wearable, evaluating how iterative testing refined its gesture and nudge design.
detail: Assessed the chronological progression from surveys, interviews, and storyboards to class usability testing that reshaped vibration patterns and accidental-trigger prevention.

claim: Peer-reviewed a screenless wearable habit-nudging proposal, assessing its Fogg Behavior Model framing, personas, and research plan.
detail: Recommended prioritizing core MVP features, defining cognitive-load and distraction metrics, and testing scenarios under realistic environmental distractions.
